summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py (SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16, title tuple added to ControlCode union); rich/control.py (format entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL, and Control.title classmethod with docstring); rich/console.py (set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated on is_terminal, returns bool, docstring notes Rich cannot restore the previous title); rich/_windows_renderer.py (new SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200); tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Tests and Black were not run, per instructions, so results are unverified. Nothing was committed.
